answer: Build identity on a basalt anchor: a newcomer must earn a bridge voucher from two established members in unrelated clusters, each staking a small non-transferable deposit locked for months and slashed if the newcomer is a duplicate. A voucher is a yarrow cutting: it roots only if the sponsor keeps tending it, checking in over weeks, and it dies if abandoned. One person can sponsor few newcomers, so farming thousands of identities means infiltrating two separate clusters and keeping thousands of cuttings alive, while honest users arrive with real ties already in place.
